messages:
Evan K: Hi @people-ops — confidential request: I’ll be bringing my service dog to the office starting next month for mobility support after a recent surgery. I need approval and a few accommodations (near-exit desk, small supply storage, permission to crate under desk). Prefer minimal notif and confidentiality.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Evan  we can support this. Quick Qs: do you have a provider note or documentation you’d like to share? Do you want us to notify only Facilities and your manager with the reason redacted? I’ll DM the intake form and our Service Animal policy.

Evan K: I can share a letter from my PT. Please notify only Facilities + my manager; keep details redacted in any team comms. I’ll follow office rules and ensure the dog is crated when at my desk.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case opened: AC-2026-4120. Maya assigned.

Priya (Manager): Evan  I fully support this and will accommodate schedule/desk changes. If needed, tell the team "Evan will have a workplace accommodation" rather than medical specifics.

Jordan (Facilities): We can reserve Desk 2B near the ground-floor exit and hold a small storage cubby for supplies. We recommend offering a private proximity advisory to immediate neighbors in case of allergies; would you like that sent (redacted)?

Maya (People Ops): DM sent with secure intake link: https://redwood.hr/service-animal-accom (private). Process: 1) submit documentation (optional by jurisdiction), 2) People Ops + Facilities coordinate low-visibility desk placement, 3) we offer a short neighbor advisory with no medical details, 4) finalize case and checklist. Legal will do a quick liability check if needed.

Evan K: Submitted the PT letter via the intake form. Please proceed with Desk 2B and the storage cubby. For the advisory, please use: "Heads-up: a colleague will have a certified service animal near Desk 2B for medical support. Contact People Ops if you have severe allergies and we’ll work through options." Keep any health details out of public notes.

LegalBot: Noted  we'll review the liability checklist and confirm no additional insurance is required.

Jordan (Facilities): Desk 2B and the cubby reserved. We'll place a mat and ship a collapsible water bowl and crate pad. I’ll send the neighbor advisory privately to adjacent desks with the redacted wording.

Priya (Manager): I’ll avoid assigning Evan to front-row onstage rotations near 2B for two weeks and will ask schedulers to prefer remote panels if teammates raise allergy concerns.

Maya (People Ops): Case AC-2026-4120 updated: service animal accommodation approved (Desk 2B, supplies provided, neighbor advisory pending). Follow-up scheduled in 14 days to confirm setup and address any issues.

Evan K: Thank you all  really appreciate the quick, private handling.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 14 days for AC-2026-4120.
